CREATIVE ARTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

2. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.

3. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

8. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.
